dialogue.content: こんにちわ
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたので、始めさせていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's our scheduled time. Would it be alright if we begin?

dialogue.content: はいよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 本日相談員をさせていただきます。ご年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I'll be your counselor today. Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 17才 女です。
dialogue.English: I'm 17 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますでは、本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないです。
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 高校に通いたくないという理解でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do I understand correctly that you don't want to attend high school?

dialogue.content: 高校に行きづらくなりました。
dialogue.English: It's become difficult for me to go to high school.

dialogue.content: 行きづらいのですね　何か原因はあったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see—it's been difficult to go. Do you think there was anything that led to that?

dialogue.content: 仲の良かった友達から私がその子のことを色々な人に話したと誤解され気まづくなって
dialogue.English: A close friend of mine misunderstood and thought I was talking about her to a lot of people, and things have gotten awkward.

dialogue.content: その子の仲の良い子達からインスタのフォローを外されました。
dialogue.English: and her close friends unfollowed me on Instagram.

dialogue.content: 仲の良い友達に、、それはショックだったよね　いつそのことがあったの？
dialogue.English: From a close friend... that must have been a shock. When did that happen?

dialogue.content: 2月に入ってからです。
dialogue.English: It started in February.

dialogue.content: もう１か月もモンモンと過ごしていたんだね辛かったね
dialogue.English: So you've been worrying about this for a whole month now. That must have been tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その色んな人に話をした内容についてはお話できる？
dialogue.English: Would you be able to tell me what they think you said to others?

dialogue.content: それと何とお呼びしたらいいかな？
dialogue.English: Also, what should I call you?

dialogue.content: わかるようなは何も話していないのに誤解されてしまったんです...はると呼んで下さい。
dialogue.English: I didn't say anything like that, but I've been misunderstood... Please call me Haru.

dialogue.content: わかるようなはうちまちがえました
dialogue.English: 'Wakaruyouna' was a typo.

dialogue.content: 私はです
dialogue.English: I meant 'I'.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ　ありがとう
dialogue.English: That's alright, thank you.

dialogue.content: はるさんは　誰にもしゃべっていないのに、疑われているのかな？それとも誰かがはるさんが言っていたといわれたのかな？
dialogue.English: Haru, are you being suspected even though you haven't told anyone? Or did someone claim that you said it?

dialogue.content: 誰かが私がその子のことを言いふらしていると言ったことで一気に広まったみたいです。
dialogue.English: It seems like someone said I was spreading rumors about her, and it just spread like wildfire.

dialogue.content: それは酷いね
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: それで仲の良いお友達もはるさんがしゃべったと思っているんだね？
dialogue.English: So your close friend also believes you were the one who said it?

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それは周りから疑いの目で見られて悲しくなってくるよね
dialogue.English: Being looked at with suspicion by those around you would make anyone feel sad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同じ学年だけでなく
dialogue.English: It's not just my grade,

dialogue.content: 1年生にも広まっています
dialogue.English: it's spread to the first-years too.

dialogue.content: 結構学校中に広がりそうなんだね不安になってくるねその仲の良いお友達とはお話できたの？
dialogue.English: It sounds like it's spreading throughout the school. That must be very unsettling. Were you able to talk to your close friend about it?

dialogue.content: この前、先生を交えて話しをすることは出来たんですけど
dialogue.English: The other day, I was able to talk with them with a teacher present, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: その後にフォローを外されました
dialogue.English: After that, she unfollowed me.

dialogue.content: 話あいが良い結果にならなかったんだねその時はるさんはどのように接したのかな？
dialogue.English: The discussion didn't lead to a good outcome. How did you approach it, Haru?

dialogue.content: 自分の気持ちをちゃんと伝えました
dialogue.English: I clearly expressed how I felt.

dialogue.content: どんな事を伝えられたのか聞いてもいい？
dialogue.English: May I ask what you told them?

dialogue.content: 誤解されてしまっているけれど、私は言いふらすということはしていないから以前のように接したいと伝えました。
dialogue.English: I told her that even though she misunderstood, I didn't spread any rumors and that I wanted us to go back to how we were before.

dialogue.content: すみません相手が私に伝えたことですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, are you asking what she said to me?

dialogue.content: いえ、はるさんがお友達にです。だからはるさんだけに教えてもらっていたことを誰にもしゃべっていないことは言えたんだね
dialogue.English: No, what you said to your friend. So you were able to tell her that you didn't tell anyone what she had told you in confidence.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時のお友達はどんな感じだったの？
dialogue.English: How did your friend seem at that time?

dialogue.content: 先生がいたからか真剣な感じでした。でも話し合いの後に
dialogue.English: Maybe because the teacher was there, she seemed serious. But after the discussion...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私が学校に行きづらくなったのは私の被害妄想が強いんじゃない？って言ってたそうです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, she said something like, "Isn't it that it's hard for you to go to school because you're just being paranoid?"

dialogue.content: そんなことを、、というのは別の人からそのことを聞いたのかな？
dialogue.English: She said that...? Did you hear about it from someone else?

dialogue.content: 携帯でやり取りしている子から聞きました。
dialogue.English: I heard it from someone I was texting with.

dialogue.content: そんな事を言われたらショックだよねその子の事で悩んでいるのに。
dialogue.English: That must be so shocking to hear, especially since you're already struggling because of her.

dialogue.content: 信じられなかったです
dialogue.English: I couldn't believe it.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話をまとめてみたいと思いますがいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to try and summarize what we've talked about so far, is that okay?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はるさんは　仲良しのお友達がいたのに、その子の事をいろんな人にしゃべっていると学校中にうわさされて２月から　学校に行きづらい状況にいます
dialogue.English: Haru, you had a close friend, but rumors spread throughout the school that you were talking about her to various people, and since February, it's become difficult for you to go to school.

dialogue.content: 先生を交えて本人を目の前に誤解を解いてもらうことをしたにもかかわらず、被害妄想が強いで終わってしまって、以前のような関係が修復できていないと感じているのですね
dialogue.English: And even though you tried to clear up the misunderstanding with her face-to-face with a teacher present, it was dismissed as you being paranoid, and you feel that your former relationship hasn't been repaired.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はるさんにとって、大事な友達だったのにもう信用も失ってきてしまったのですねいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: She was an important friend to you, yet it sounds like trust has been lost. How does that feel for you?

dialogue.content: 信用を失うというか悲しいです
dialogue.English: It's not so much about losing trust; I just feel sad.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまうのは当然です。誰だって信じてもらえないのは悲しいですよ
dialogue.English: It's completely natural to feel that way. Anyone would feel sad not being believed.

dialogue.content: 泣きたい気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: It makes you feel like crying, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい...
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: はるさんは何も悪いことはしていないのだから
dialogue.English: Haru, you haven't done anything wrong.

dialogue.content: 何度か泣きました
dialogue.English: I've cried several times.

dialogue.content: かならず誤解は解けます
dialogue.English: The misunderstanding will surely be cleared up.

dialogue.content: 明日からテストなので
dialogue.English: I have tests starting tomorrow, so...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 不安なんですけど受けに行って
dialogue.English: I'm anxious, but I'll go take them and...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どんな感じかわかることがあると思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll get a sense of how things are.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　テスト前なのにずっと悩んでいたのは辛かったね
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been so hard to be worrying about this right before your tests.

dialogue.content: テスト勉強はあまり出来ていなかったので
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to study much for the tests, so...

dialogue.content: 結果は良くないと思うんですけどとりあえずテストは受けないとって思います
dialogue.English: I don't think my results will be good, but I feel I have to at least take the tests.

dialogue.content: うんうん　頑張っているのが伝わります
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I can see how hard you're trying.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: また、お友達の状況が分かったら相談にきてくださいね　過去の履歴から相談に乗れると思います。
dialogue.English: Please come back and talk to me again when you have an update on the situation with your friend. I think I can help you based on our past conversation history.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談にきてくれてありがとうはるさんを応援していますから安心してテストを受けてきてね
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk today. I'm cheering you on, Haru, so go take your tests with peace of mind.

dialogue.content: はい良い報告が出来るといいなって思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I hope I'll be able to give you good news.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました😃
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. 😃

dialogue.content: そう信じていますはるさんは正直で本当に優しい子だと思いました。また　待ってますね
dialogue.English: I believe you will. I found you to be an honest and truly kind person. I'll be here waiting to hear from you again.

dialogue.content: それでは終了メッセージを送りますがよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Shall I send the closing message now?

dialogue.content: はい😊
dialogue.English: Yes 😊
